steps.en: Officer sees a work item for the address error
steps.id: Officer melihat work item untuk error alamat
steps.why_en: No work item is created; errors only appear in an emailed report.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada work item; error hanya muncul di report email.

steps.en: The notice page shows the saved address
steps.why_en: It is the general notice page, not a warrant address-error screen.
steps.why_id: Ini halaman notice umum, bukan layar error alamat warrant.

steps.en: The notice page shows address dates
steps.why_en: The dates are general notice data, not warrant check dates.
steps.why_id: Tanggalnya data notice umum, bukan tanggal pengecekan warrant.

steps.en: Officer decides on the Letter of Advice from this view
steps.id: Officer memutuskan Letter of Advice dari tampilan ini
steps.why_en: Only menu labels exist; no decision screen is built.
steps.why_id: Hanya label menu; layar keputusan tidak dibuat.
